_about: Third fit-judge ticket set, written and committed BEFORE the shortlist (top-15) judge or the Groq-written map was evaluated. Used once per configuration to compare top-5 vs shortlist-15. Duplicates are deliberately phrased far from the assets' own wording.

tasks.ticket: Every backend team keeps rewriting ring membership, rate limiting and service lifecycle code. Is there a shared Go library for that?
Our browser-based checks need a sidecar that launches Chrome on request and kills hung instances.
Detect whether a metric has a weekly cycle before we pick a forecasting model.
Across a fleet of pods, tell me which pod's latency curve does not look like the others.
Before merging, reject dashboard JSON that uses deprecated panels or hard-coded datasources.
Alert us when our GitHub App is close to exhausting its API quota.
A UI where people click together an OpenTelemetry collector pipeline instead of writing YAML by hand.
We need the logic that evaluates alert rules and routes notifications to chat and paging tools; we do not want to write our own.
Write a function that checks whether a year is a leap year.
Add a helper that converts kilometres per hour to miles per hour.
Generate a QR code PNG for a given URL.
Write a function that calculates compound interest for a savings plan.
Add a profanity filter for user-submitted comments.
Parse two semantic version strings and tell which one is newer.
